stem: An IPM report says affected-plant count fell from 12 to 8, but the first round sampled 60 plants and the second sampled 20. Which statement is correct?
choices: Incidence improved because 8 is less than 12
Normalized incidence rose from 20% to 40%, so the raw-count decrease does not show improvement
Sample size never matters when using counts
rationale: Comparable rates require denominators. The apparent raw-count improvement reverses after normalization: 12/60 = 20%, 8/20 = 40%.
